sourceSentences: [0] And if Warwick is below 50% HP, he also heals for 100% of the damage dealt by the passive. If he's below 25% HP, the healing is increased to 250% of the damage.
[0] So you get movement speed steroid and an attack speed steroid against enemies who are below 50% HP. And the steroid gets increased further when they're below 25% HP.
[0] will start hunting them and I will get the bonuses of attack speed and movement speed toward them for 8 seconds. So it treats the target as if it's below 50% HP.
[0] You gain a portion of damage reduction for 2 and 1/2 seconds, and after it ends, you fear nearby enemies. You can also recast the ability to end it early.
[0] Warwick leaps a huge distance that scales with his movement speed and suppresses the first target hit.
[0] This will also make Warwick's ult shorter range if you get significantly slowed.
[0] So if they try to flash away while you're queuing, it will follow them. If Ezreal tries to leap away with E, it will follow him.
[0] Just keep in mind that because Warwick has a lot of sustain, enemies usually will buy anti-heal, which means life steal and omnivamp will lose value.
[1] Unless your champion is a powerful duelist (Fiora, Irelia, Aatrox, Master Yi, Riven, Yasuo, etc.), do not attempt to fight Warwick 1v1 as he will certainly outsustain you and win in a long fight.
[1] If you are above 50% health and suddenly see the red wolf-face icon above your champion, it means that Warwick has activated Blood Hunt on you and will probably be coming for you
[1] It is advised to back away or play very defensive for the duration.
[1] the Active component of Blood Hunt will always mark only the closest enemy.
[1] Although not practical, try remaining above 50% health so that Warwick cannot detect you.
[1] Warwick cannot be stopped while mid-air during his ultimate, but can be CC'd out of his suppress.
[1] Try to save any hard crowd control effects (stuns, silences, knockup, etc.) for this moment to save teammates.
[1] Grievous Wounds items overall are good against Warwick because they reduce his healing power.
[1] Warwick is very reliant on sustain to survive.
